preconditions.description: The number of strings n is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string in the input list has a length between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Each string in the input list consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by n strings, each on a new line.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or all(strings[i] in strings[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', each string in the output list (except the last one) is a substring of the next string.
